title: Agent interface
what: A chat panel an app links to put the brokered agent on its pages: a launcher (floating button, right-edge tab or header button), a docked, resizable sidebar that pushes the page instead of covering it, past conversations for this app or all apps, and distinct unconfigured / failed / empty states. It talks only to the APP's own bridge endpoints; the app's server forwards to /hub/api/agent/* with its hub credential, and the agent key never leaves the hub.
mount: . Optional: an element with data-hub-agent-header receives the header button; any element with data-hub-agent-open opens the panel.

bridge.ask: POST JSON {question, thread, conversation_id} -> forward to POST /hub/api/agent/ask adding {app, person} from the app's own sign-in; return the hub's JSON unchanged.
bridge.profile: GET -> forward to GET /hub/api/profile?person= and return its data (the person's `agent` placement is honoured when the app allows it).

events.hub:component-props: window event, detail {app, props}; props.agent overrides the fetched values without a reload
events.hub:agent-open: dispatch on window to open the panel; detail {question} pre-fills and sends
events.hub:agent-ask: dispatch on document, cancelable, detail {question}: the panel opens and asks it as if typed, and cancels the event so the sender knows it was taken (the context menu's "Ask the agent" uses it); a question already in flight is not interrupted -- the new one waits in the box
